summary: Enhance your expertise with our Managing Energy Security and Supply Training. Learn strategies to ensure reliable energy management and supply stability.
lede: Energy security and supply management covers assessing energy supply risks and planning for resilient, efficient operations. It is for professionals in energy management, sustainability, operations, supply chains and risk who need to develop practical energy strategies. The syllabus includes using analytics and dashboards to monitor performance, setting energy targets, planning for disruptions, and engaging stakeholders in energy initiatives.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across the energy management spectrum.
modules: Setting and Tracking Energy Performance Targets
Integrating Emerging Technologies in Energy Management
prerequisites: This course requires a basic understanding of energy management principles and prior experience in energy-related roles.
